text: 、"This program is to cultivate students to master basic theory and knowledge of tourism management subjects, know the development in tourism, aquire the ability of analyzing and settling problems by utilizing tourism management theory and be qualified for careers in tourism administration departments at all leves, tourism enterprizes and tourism institutions. Major Courses: Management, Micro-economics, Macro-economics, Accounting, Management Information System, Statistics, Financial Management, Marketing Management, Economic Law, Brief Introduction of Tourism, Tourism Economics, Hotel Management Principle, Tourism Resources and Their Development, etc. Degree Awarded: Bachelor’s Degree in Management"
